g.text: Paired changes in geographic held-out RMSE · negative values indicate improvement
All five primary paired comparisons. Bars are frozen 95% geographic-composition stability ranges from 2,000 neighbourhood resamples. They are not
independent-sample confidence intervals; a range crossing zero does not establish equivalence. MW−ME is replacement; MEW−ME is network add-on.
